info.title: PCMMAD Receiver v10.3 Native Protocol Compact Control Surface + Capability Router
info.description: Behavior-preserving 30-operation Custom GPT control surface for the PCMMAD Receiver V29 native-protocol release candidate. The imported surface remains intentionally compact; GET /capabilities and GET /lab/tools expose the wider server capability contract, while /lab/dispatch, /lab/batch, and /lab/results/get route into server-native tools including the append-only typed PCMMAD protocol plane without schema churn.

background.description: When true, the server executes the batch in a background thread and returns a handle retrievable via /lab/results/get.

parallelism.description: Server-side per-batch parallelism hint. Sequential semantics remain the default.

LabBatchRequest.description: Schema-side batch cap is 30 steps for GPT action compatibility. Server-side orchestration may exceed this through background/server-managed workflows.

mode.description: Bounded retrieval mode. auto returns full only when safely inline; otherwise preview. Use metadata for identity only, preview for bounded summary, range for exact byte slices, or full explicitly.

length_bytes.description: Requested byte length when mode=range; server hard-cap is 65536 bytes.

preview_chars.description: Preview character budget when mode=preview or auto selects preview.

summary_only.description: Historical compatibility alias. true forces preview mode; prefer mode=preview for new clients.

effective_approval_required_tools.description: Count of family tools whose effective runtime policy requires approval, including requirements derived from mutation/danger policy rather than only declared approval_required metadata.

BoundApprovalAuthority.description: Optional runtime authority envelope for a previously issued target/argument/contract-bound approval challenge. Authority is separate from capability arguments.

approval_handle.description: Opaque single-use approval challenge handle issued by the runtime.

permit.description: Explicit operator confirmation. A handle alone does not authorize execution.

RuntimeAuthorityEnvelope.description: Runtime authority envelope. Approval and project mutation authority are independent dimensions and are validated by the runtime as required by the invoked capability.

get.summary: Full capability manifest plus compact-to-server capability router contract

post.description: Server blocks until the job reaches a terminal state or timeout_seconds elapses. Returns full stdout/stderr on completion. Use after submitProjectExecution when runSync is not applicable.

get.summary: List dispatchable lab tools plus server-native capability families
get.description: Lists dispatchable server-side lab tools and exposes the explicit bridge from the compact schema surface into the larger server-native capability set.

post.summary: Dispatch a server-side lab tool by name
post.description: Dispatch one server-native lab capability through the canonical runtime router. For approval-gated calls, first receive the runtime approval challenge, then retry with the exact challenge in the separate top-level authority envelope; do not embed approval inside payload.

post.summary: Run multiple lab tool calls in sequence
post.description: Dispatch up to 30 server-native lab steps. Each step carries capability arguments in payload and, when required, its own separate Runtime authority envelope. Batch does not imply transaction/atomicity.

post.summary: Fetch stored result metadata, preview, byte range, auto-bounded content, or explicit full payload
post.description: Prefer auto/metadata/preview/range for bounded model context. full is explicit opt-in. Historical summary_only=true remains an alias for preview.
